definition_records.name: QuantumState.Qudit
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Finite-dimensional complete complex inner-product-space structure; compatible norm. No quantum estimate.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannel.CPTP
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Complex linear map; inherited matrix-amplification positivity at every finite k; trace preservation on all operators. Complete positivity fields are at mathlib CompletelyPositiveMap.lean:50-55.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.DensityState
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Actual positive endomorphism of trace1; singular states admitted.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.PureInput
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: All norm-one vectors; actual rank-one outer-product density. Standard basis used only to prove Nonempty, never to restrict optimization.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.toBits
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Positive multiplication by inverse natural log2, with +infinity preserved by checked theorem.

definition_records.name: SandwichedRenyiRelativeEntropy.suppLE
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: ker sigma <= ker rho, the positive-operator support inclusion convention.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.stateRenyi
definition_records.reason: Actual trace sandwich powers scaled to bits. Above1, support mismatch gives infinity. Below1, zero trace gives infinity. Imported normalization denominator equals1. Finite formulas and infinity branches have separate checked Lean lemmas.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.stateRelative
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Actual Umegaki trace logarithm formula divided by log2 on support inclusion and infinity on support mismatch.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.amplifiedOutput
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Literal N tensor id action on arbitrary, possibly entangled operators; complete positivity and normalization proved. Manuscript id tensor N comparison closed by SourceCorrespondence.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.channelRenyi
definition_records.reason: Full pure-input supremum with reference a copy of input space. ENNReal conversion is exact by state nonnegativity on admissible orders. Tensor-factor convention closed by separate source correspondence.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.channelRelative
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Full pure-input supremum with same reference dimension. ENNReal conversion exact by proved relative-entropy nonnegativity, including infinity.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.tensorChannel
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Literal tensor product via canonical operator tensor equivalence. All-amplification positivity and trace preservation constructed.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.tensorPowerSpace/channelPower
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Actual recursive tensor powers with one-dimensional zero-copy identity. One-copy and regrouping isometries are independently proved. Reference dimension multiplication is mathematical review, not standalone compiled finrank evidence.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.blockRenyi
definition_records.reason: Actual stabilized divergence of the supplied n-copy channels.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.blockRelative
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Actual stabilized relative entropy of the supplied n-copy channels.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.regularizedRenyi
definition_records.reason: Supremum of normalized positive blocks; n0 excluded by index. Separate checked Fekete identity supplies limit definition.

definition_records.name: QuantumChannelContinuity.regularizedRelative
definition_records.scope: finite nonzero complex Hilbert spaces with normalized states
definition_records.reason: Supremum of normalized positive blocks; no optimizer witness or extra additivity assumption. Separate checked identity supplies limit definition.

representation_bridge.semantic_review: Passed independent agent review; actual id tensor N action on arbitrary operators plus a bijection of full pure-input suprema

supplementary_definition_probe.omitted_optional_probe: standalone finrank identity after instance-synthesis timeouts; never counted as passed

recorded_result.scope: exact-type, defining-equation, normalization, domain and axiom probes

stale_pass_negative_control.induced_failure: Temporarily replace one recorded audit input SHA-256 with zeroes; no Lean sources changed

limitations: Nonzero spaces are the conventional quantum-system interpretation, but the paper does not explicitly exclude zero-dimensional algebraic carriers.
Real-order definitions are totalized at order one and outside the source domain; the punctured limit excludes one and eventually lies in the source domain.

Tensor-power dimension follows the audited recursion and standard dimension multiplication; a separate optional finrank proof was omitted after instance-synthesis timeouts and is not claimed as checked evidence.
This is agent semantic review plus kernel checks, not a machine certificate of the English-to-Lean translation or independent human certification.
